units: Prov. XII, 18) the tongue of the wise teaches medicine (indirectly, ref. to Pes. II, 7).—Esp. ‘your health’, a wish uttered to one sneezing.
Tosef. Sabb. VII (VIII), 5 האומר מ׳ הרי זה וכ׳ (not האמר) to say marpé is a superstitious practice (v. אֱמוֹרִי).
Ib. לא אמר מ׳ מפני וכ׳ did not say m. (at college), because it is an interruption of study; Ber. 53ᵃ
